result.reason: The clause substantially implements the preferred structure: a mutual USD 1,000,000/12-month-fees cap, mutual consequential-damages exclusion, all requested uncapped categories, and treatment of Sparkling’s payment obligations outside damages. However, the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim, as the playbook specifies; those dates can produce materially different caps. Drafting is also weakened by the run-on Excluded Claims definition and the overlap between that definition and the existing Sections 13 and 14 exception.
